observations: Seller confirms verbally that they tested it yesterday, but provides no new photos/videos.
No controller, ports, receipt, or model/label details are newly shown beyond the original two photos.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Original photos do not show a readable PS4 Pro identifier; no controller is shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No seals/tamper indicators or inside/service evidence shown.
No gameplay/temperature/fan test evidence shown; seller only asserts testing.
No close-up of ports and no functional port test evidence shown; seller only asserts testing.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No controller(s) or receipt shown in photos; seller only asserts.

risks.risk: PS4 Pro model may be incorrect (could be another PS4 revision), affecting value.
risks.proof: Clear rear label photo showing model/version (PS4 Pro) and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used PS4 console (worst-case vs Pro).

risks.risk: Controller may be missing/incorrect/defective despite claim.
risks.proof: Photo of the controller included + short clip pairing and working in menus/game.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no working controller).

risks.risk: Ports may fail under use (HDMI/USB/power), or audio may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video: power on → home screen → controller works; show HDMI output; test at least one USB port charging/data.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potential port issues.

risks.risk: Thermal/fan issue may appear after longer use than seller’s brief test.
risks.proof: Clip of 15–20 minutes gameplay with no shutdown + fan noise check (ideally temperature reading).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” may be false; parts may be replaced.
risks.proof: Photo of any warranty/tamper seals and clear exterior inspection; ideally inside photo if possible.

proof_requests: Send 1 clear photo of the console rear label showing PS4 Pro model/version + serial.
Send 1 photo of the included controller(s) and what’s in the box (power lead, HDMI, etc.).
Send a short video: power on → home screen loads → controller connects and works.
Send a short video showing HDMI output and at least one USB port working (controller charging/data).
Send a photo/screenshot of the UK receipt (or any proof of purchase).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only verbal and does not replace missing visual proof. Without new photos/videos, the PS4 Pro identity and functional claims (ports/controller/overheating/receipt) remain unverified, so a reliable worst-case price still can’t be set.
